The '''''Blue Flare''''' was an old [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that belonged to [[Sona Fey'lya]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. At some point, [[Logron]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], took away the ''Blue Flare'' as payback. She later was able to steal it with the help of the Pero brothers and an adventurer.
